objects.name: Last bus notice
lines: 9:20. The last bus home. Mom asked me to call when I got on.
Eight minutes to return one mixer. No extra favors. That is the plan.

objects.name: Bicycle / Eli's repair tag
lines: Eli fixed the brake for free. I owe him a coffee, and a brake that stays fixed.

objects.name: Mara / mural painter
lines: That bag looks heavier than your future. Are you returning something or accepting a quest?
A mixer. I am not accepting the other thing.
The UMC is through the underpass, past the bus shelter. Follow the arrows. Do not let the club poster negotiate.

objects.name: Path under Broadway to the UMC

U02.name: UMC terrace / the doors are open

objects.name: Mags / night porter
lines: Arts night. Last Light. Everyone brings something unfinished; I bring the mop.
I just need to return Imani's mixer and leave.
Club room, left of the atrium. Returning a thing is a complete task. Remember that.
If the building asks for your entire future, try asking for a receipt.

objects.name: Eli / bike mechanic
lines: The new brake holds. Your backpack, on the other hand, needs a structural engineer.
There is a mixer in it.
Good. If the building starts singing, you can ask it to use headphones.

objects.name: Squirrel with an impressive schedule
lines: It has one acorn and no outstanding commitments. I should learn from it.

objects.name: UMC room directory
lines: CLUB ROOM: left door. REPAIR LANDING: stairs. THE CONNECTION: downstairs.
LOST PROPERTY: past the lanes. Somebody drew a question mark next to it.

objects.name: Todd Saliman / listening booth
lines: The finite-plan desk is in Old Main. This hall only has the directory.

objects.name: An unfinished-reading club
lines: We read things nobody had time to finish. One page is enough.
Maybe I can understand that without joining twelve committees.

objects.name: Stage cue sheet
lines: I made the evening sound enormous because I was scared nobody would come.
Small is allowed. You can put that on the poster.

U05.name: Repair landing / down is a direction

objects.name: A humming maintenance panel
lines: A fuse labeled TOMORROW is lit. Yesterday is missing.
Do not pull it. First we find what it powers.

objects.name: Mags / spare keys
lines: Lost property has been returning things nobody remembers losing. And somebody in there keeps asking about degree audits.
Take Cal. He knows which noises are machinery and which are opinions.

objects.name: Lost property / the voice in the wall
Deion Sanders / a clean handoff
lines: You can sprint forever, or you can hand something to a teammate. Which one gets you home?
Is this advice or a drill?
Both. Jump the low hurdles. Duck the high ones. Then take a break.

objects.name: Mara / a familiar face
lines: The mural followed me down the stairs. Very inconsiderate of a two-dimensional object.
Listen: the squeak beyond that door is trying to say somebody's name.

objects.name: Bowling lanes / rolling stars
lines: The ball returns are working. The pins are refusing to be scored.
For once, I support a machine with a boundary.

objects.name: Club scorecard / one round is enough
lines: A scorecard asks for a partner, not a perfect score. Someone circled ONE ROUND.
A promise with an ending. Pin Pal could use one of those.

objects.name: Next-up board / names before numbers
lines: The board lists people, then refuses to rank them.
Pin Pal wants a practice partner. One round can be a complete promise.

objects.name: Ball return / the same request
lines: The paddle works. Pin Pal keeps sending the same ball back.
We should ask what one round means before agreeing to play forever.

U07.name: Lost property / who wants this back?

objects.name: Pip / glove or departure note
lines: You found me! I was worried they would file me under LEFT, forever.
Do I need one to come along?

objects.name: Warm shelf light / rest and save
Ticket spool / changed by the encounter
lines: There is a whole shelf of things that people chose not to carry anymore.

objects.name: Old radio / mid-repair
lines: A radio with its back off. Every tube is labelled in tiny careful handwriting.
The dial is parked between stations. It hums like it is waiting for someone to speak.

objects.name: Shopping cart / everything that matters
lines: Blankets, a bag of radio parts, a sealed jar of coffee. Packed like it has moved a lot.

objects.name: Mural / the Flatirons at dusk
lines: Somebody painted the Flatirons down here, where nobody can see the real ones.
Signed in the corner: 'For whoever is still walking.'

objects.name: Crossed-out club notice
lines: EVERYONE THIS WAY is crossed out. Below, in neon marker: pick one line.
A club notice that can admit a mistake. Promising.

objects.name: Rook / night marshal
lines: Rook / night marshal. One thing at a time.

objects.name: Volunteers / one final task
lines: Volunteers / one final task. One thing at a time.

objects.name: Three volunteers, one shift
lines: The list says three volunteers. The stage has called them forty times.
A shift should have an end.

objects.name: Three mugs on a drying rack
lines: One has a chipped handle. I can wrap it when the rack is dry.
When it is dry. A very specific later.

objects.name: Mags / closing the food cart
lines: Soup is off. Counter is clean. The cart is going home.
Even the cart gets a stopping cue.

objects.name: Chip / one bounded rehearsal
lines: The crowd keeps being called back. Can we rehearse an ending?
Three called columns. Then applause can be quiet.
And everyone gets to sit down.

objects.name: Imani / choose a finite performance
lines: Imani / choose a finite performance. One thing at a time.

objects.name: Crossed-out encore cue
lines: The cue sheet says AGAIN. I am writing STOP underneath.
Make that word visible from the back row.

objects.name: ENCORE / the show that will not end
lines: ENCORE / the show that will not end. One thing at a time.

objects.name: Stage rest light
lines: Stage rest light. One thing at a time.

N01.name: Norlin steps / the page before the door

objects.name: One useful stopping point
lines: A student marked where they stopped reading, not where they failed.
There is room beside that mark for someone else to begin.

objects.name: Nell / one borrower at a time
Return slip / not a debt
lines: Due back when you are done. Someone crossed out FOREVER.
The desk has limits. That is how it stays useful.

objects.name: A second set of notes
lines: Two hands worked on this page. Different ink. Neither erased the other.
The polished recording made all my breaths disappear. I want those back.

objects.name: Shelf crank / reveal a service aisle
The sentence under the red marks
lines: I came back because I said I would. The pencil wants to replace SAID with MUST.
Keep the first sentence. A promise can be chosen.

objects.name: Birds in the roof garden
lines: They have no opinion about the recording. This is refreshing.
They do have an opinion about your granola. Keep the lid on.

N06.name: Closed archive / AUTOCOMPLETE is still typing

objects.name: Reserved seats / a ceremony for possibilities

N07.name: Playback room / the source of the promise

objects.name: Source reel / hear what was promised
A spare pair of headphones
lines: One pair will not fit three people.
Then use the speaker. Shared problems do not require matching ears.

E01.name: Engineering loading court / a path you can use

objects.name: A shared-work notice
lines: The note says ASK BEFORE LIFTING. Somebody has added ASK FOR HELP.
The second line looks like Cal's handwriting.

objects.name: Cal / the model with no supports
The warm desk lamp / rest and save
Two names on every borrowed tool
lines: These tools have Cal AND Dev on the tags.
Evidence that nobody built the whole evening alone.

E03.name: Test floor / put the load somewhere real

objects.name: The scope cart / every signal needs a way home
lines: Three test points circled in red. Somebody wrote LOOK BEFORE YOU TRUST next to them.
And a sticky note that says GO HOME, ERIC. In his own handwriting.

E04.name: Suspended model / above the test floor

objects.name: Cal and Dev's bridge / revise the span
Perfect arch / nobody can cross
lines: The drawing looks beautiful from the bottom.
It needs somewhere for a person to stand at the top.

E05.name: Control booth / the recording nobody made

objects.name: Source reel / return it to Norlin
A night marshal signed the log

O01.name: Old Main courtyard / the last open office

objects.name: Rook / a shift that will not end
A tree with an ordinary shadow
lines: The shadow has no opinion about what we should become.
I am spending a whole minute with that tree after this.

O02.name: Notice hall / who gets to say no

objects.name: A hand-lettered directory
lines: Empty office: original ceremony directory. Cabinet room: finite-plan desk.

objects.name: Open again in the morning
lines: The office hours have an end. The building survives that.

objects.name: A quiet window
lines: People will need this room when the sun is up.
Then we will leave it a room, not a future.

objects.name: No blank signature lines
lines: Ask a question before signing. Leave space for a different answer.

M01.name: Procession walk / no one has to march

objects.name: Mags / a thermos and a stopping time
Birds waiting for morning
lines: They are not waiting to graduate.
They are waiting for breakfast. An excellent finite plan.

M02.name: Macky lobby / a choice of doors

objects.name: Two branches / one way forward
lines: Cloakroom left: guests can leave. Orchestra pit right: Imani chooses the score. Balcony above: Rook has the stage key.

objects.name: A coat check for possible people
No attendance debt
lines: Having a ticket means you can enter. It does not mean you owe the room your whole night.

M04.name: Orchestra pit / the score can end

objects.name: An unfinished rest
lines: Someone wrote REST above the silence.
That part is not missing. It is part of the music.

objects.name: A room filled with reserved chairs
lines: The chairs keep multiplying. Every future gets a place; every living person loses one.

M06.name: Graduation stage / everyone you could be

objects.name: Seats no one chose
lines: A reserved chair can become a chair again. It does not have to hold a whole future.
I can hold the door. Nobody has to be lost first.

M07.name: Dawn exit / the campus belongs to morning

objects.name: The party / what stays with us
Ordinary morning birds
lines: That is enough sound for this minute.

objects.name: Jakerson / in the second row
lines: You made it to the front row. I only made the second.

objects.name: The podium / names read out
lines: They read every name. Even the ones who almost didn't stay.

objects.name: Jakerson / one friendly set
lines: One set. No scores kept. Well, I'll keep them.

objects.name: Ball machine / LOB, TOPSPIN, MERCY
lines: Three settings: LOB, TOPSPIN and MERCY. Someone taped over MERCY.

objects.name: Courtside bench
lines: A water bottle, a towel and a graduation cap someone already took off.

objects.name: Jakerson / your roommate
lines: You must be Jules! I'm Jakerson. Random assignment. Lucky us.

objects.name: Your bed / bare mattress
lines: Blue vinyl. It squeaks. Sheets first, then everything else.

objects.name: Moving boxes / BOOK, JULES, MISC
lines: Three boxes and a duffel. It looked like more in the car.

objects.name: RA's welcome note
lines: A paper star with both our names on it, and FLOOR MEETING 9PM.

objects.name: West window / the Flatirons
lines: The Flatirons, right there, like someone set them on the sill.

objects.name: Jakerson's desk / laptop
lines: Half-finished code, a tiny tennis trophy and a mug of pens he has clearly never used.

objects.name: Jakerson's wall / racket and SET POINT poster
lines: A racket hung up like a guitar. He moved in yesterday and it already looks lived in.

objects.name: Box fan
lines: Mom packed a fan. Mom was right. It is ninety degrees in here.

objects.name: Move-in cart
lines: The rest of my life, in one gold rolling bin. A volunteer wants it back by six.

objects.name: Mini-fridge
lines: Cereal, apples and a magnet that says SERVE IT. Very organised.

objects.name: RA board / WELCOME HOME
lines: Floor meeting at nine, in the lobby. Quiet hours at ten. Laundry is downstairs. Someone already drew a moustache on the RA.

objects.name: Boxes marked JAKERSON
lines: TENNIS, JAKERSON, and a racket bag with a ball pocket. He moved in before I did.

objects.name: A move-in cart
lines: A lamp, a pillow, a rug and a fan. Somebody's whole room on four wheels.

objects.name: Mini fridge / FREE?
lines: FREE, with a question mark. It hums like it is nervous about it too.

objects.name: Drinking fountain
lines: The water is cold and tastes like 1949.

objects.name: Hall bench
lines: Someone left a backpack here to save a seat for the floor meeting.

objects.name: Study lounge
lines: A cooking show at full volume and nobody watching it.

objects.name: Floormate / looking for TY
lines: Have you seen a name tag that says TY?

objects.name: Stairs / up to the second floor
Mailboxes
lines: Box 214. Empty. Nobody has the address yet, not even me.

objects.name: Front desk / move-in check-in
lines: A bell, a sign-in sheet and a pile of room keys in envelopes. Mine is already gone.

objects.name: Lobby fireplace
lines: A real fire in a dorm. Somebody in 1949 was very optimistic about us.

objects.name: A cart nobody has claimed
lines: A whole room on wheels, parked by the doors. Its owner is probably upstairs looking for it.

objects.name: MOVE-IN / CHECK IN >
lines: An arrow to the desk, in case anybody gets lost in a room this size.

objects.name: LOST SOCKS board
lines: Six socks. No pairs. A whole board of things that came out alone.

objects.name: Washers
lines: CARD ONLY. Someone has taped a quarter to the sign anyway.

objects.name: Dryers / one still tumbling
lines: One dryer is still going round. Nobody is waiting for it.

objects.name: Soap machine
lines: Three kinds of soap, all the same price, all sold out but one.

objects.name: Folding table
lines: Somebody folds their shirts into perfect squares. Somebody else just left theirs.

objects.name: Floormate / folding laundry
lines: Three of these shirts are paint-stained.

objects.name: Ping-pong table
lines: WINNER STAYS ON, in marker, on the net. The winner has apparently stayed on since 1987.

objects.name: Lobby piano
lines: Chopsticks, open on the stand, and a note: PLEASE NOT AFTER 10. Two keys don't play.

objects.name: WET FLOOR
lines: A washer overflowed. Somebody used too much soap and a lot of optimism.

objects.name: Floormate / by the fire
lines: Shh. I'm at the good part.

objects.name: Jakerson / losing to the ping-pong table
